title: The Space Between
description:
The Space Between is less about what is seen and more about what is not. It is about solitude, serendipity, appreciation, and peace. It is about finding and celebrating beauty in little slices. 

Drawing on the Japanese idea of ma, the meaningful interval, the photographs treat space, light and silence as the subject itself, an invitation to stand quietly in the world. 

A reflective space. The space between.
